Class.name: IHC.ITF.Process.Bpl.RadiantLogicJsonToSalesForceXml
Class.Description: Calls RadiantLogic REST service & Converts to SalesForce XML record

Property.name: RadiantSrvcTargetConfigName
Property.Description: Radiant Logic service call Operation: The target name used for the Radiant Logic Service calls

XData.name: BPL
XData.Data: toTalNumRecds { set context.hasNext=0 } set resObj=jsonObj.Resources #dim resIter As %Iterator.Array set resIter = resObj.%GetIterator() if (##class(Ens.Util.FunctionSet).Contains(resObj,"DynamicArray")) { while resIter.%GetNext(.key,.dvalue) { $$$TRACE("KEY-: "_key) $$$TRACE("VALUE-: "_dvalue) set context.SalesForceRec=##class(EnsLib.EDI.XML.Document).%New() set context.SalesForceRec.DocType="SalesForceRec:sObject" if $isObject(dvalue) { //set context.SalesForceRec.Id=dvalue.ID do context.SalesForceRec.SetValueAt(dvalue.ID,"Id","set","") $$$TRACE("ID: "_dvalue.id) set mtObj=dvalue.meta $$$TRACE("Resource Type: "_mtObj.resourceType) $$$TRACE("Created: "_mtObj.created) set lmDt=mtObj.lastModified $$$TRACE("Last Modified: "_lmDt) $$$TRACE("Latest Modified Datetime: "_context.lastModifiedDt) set strLen=##class(Ens.Util.FunctionSet).Length(lmDt) set ms = ##class(Ens.Util.FunctionSet).SubString(lmDt,strLen-4,strLen-1) if $ZDATETIME($ZDATETIMEH(context.lastModifiedDt,3,7),-2) < $ZDATETIME($ZDATETIMEH(lmDt,3,7),-2) { set context.lastModifiedDt = lmDt set context.lastMdMs = ms $$$TRACE("Update the search Datetime...") } else { if $ZDATETIME($ZDATETIMEH(context.lastModifiedDt,3,7),-2) = $ZDATETIME($ZDATETIMEH(lmDt,3,7),-2) { if ms > context.lastMdMs { set context.lastModifiedDt = lmDt set context.lastMdMs = ms $$$TRACE("Update the search Datetime(MS)...") } } } $$$TRACE("location: "_mtObj.location) set dob=dvalue.Birthdate $$$TRACE("DOB: "_dob) if (dob'="") && (dob'="no date") { set dob=$ZDATE($ZDATEH($Replace(dob,"-"," "),2),3) } else { set dob="" } $$$TRACE("DOB: "_dob) do context.SalesForceRec.SetValueAt(dvalue.LastName,"LastName","set","") do context.SalesForceRec.SetValueAt(dvalue.FirstName,"FirstName","set","") do context.SalesForceRec.SetValueAt(dvalue.SocialSecurityNumberLast4,"Social_Security_Number_last_4__c","set","") do context.SalesForceRec.SetValueAt(dob,"Birthdate","set","") do context.SalesForceRec.SetValueAt(dvalue.LastName,"Email","set","") do context.SalesForceRec.SetValueAt(dvalue.FirstName,"Gender__c","set","") do context.SalesForceRec.SetValueAt(dvalue.Username,"Enterprise_Username__c","set","") do context.SalesForceRec.SetValueAt(dvalue.FirstName,"Current_Intermountain_Employee__c","set","") do context.SalesForceRec.SetValueAt(dvalue.Unitnumber,"MSPR_ID__c","set","") do context.SalesForceRec.SetValueAt(dvalue.FirstName,"Facility__c","set","") do context.SalesForceRec.SetValueAt(dvalue.LastName,"Rotation_Start_Date_2__c","set","") do context.SalesForceRec.SetValueAt(dvalue.FirstName,"Rotation_End_Date_2__c","set","") do context.SalesForceRec.SetValueAt(dvalue.LastName,"Computer_Access_Needed__c","set","") set activeSt=dvalue.Active if activeSt="ACTIVE" { $$$TRACE("Active: "_activeSt) set activeSt="false" } else { set activeSt="true" } do context.SalesForceRec.SetValueAt(activeSt,"Inactive__c","set","") do context.SalesForceRec.SetValueAt(dvalue.EmployeeNumber,"Employee_Number__c","set","") do context.SalesForceRec.SetValueAt(dvalue.StudentID,"Student_ID__c","set","") do context.SalesForceRec.SetValueAt(dvalue.LastName,"Non_US_National_Identifier__c","set","") do context.SalesForceRec.SetValueAt(dvalue.FirstName,"Preferred_Name__c","set","") do context.SalesForceRec.SetValueAt(dvalue.LastName,"Current_Intermountain_Employee__c","set","") do context.SalesForceRec.SetValueAt(dvalue.FirstName,"Student_Coordinator__","set","") do context.SalesForceRec.SetValueAt(dvalue.LastName,"LastName","set","") do context.SalesForceRec.SetValueAt(dvalue.FirstName,"FirstName","set","") $$$TRACE("Target Process: "_context.targetList.GetAt(1)) set process.%SuperSession="" // make each transaction a new session set process.%SessionId="" // make each transaction a new session set status=process.SendRequestAsync(context.targetList.GetAt(1),context.SalesForceRec,0) if ($$$ISOK(status)){ $$$TRACE("A Workday record is sent ...") //set ^lastSearchDtSalesForce=context.lastModifiedDt } else { $$$TRACE("Send a SalesForce record failed ...") } } } } } else { $$$TRACE("Failed to parse the JSON string ...") } ]]>
